audit.why: win[N] already matches the packet's real levelChart (Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Neeko/Skill/Skill), so it is the correct verdict; the full-layer rows are a stale 'even' template that never got updated.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2,4].side moved to 'Neeko' with matching .why rewrites grounded in Tangle-Barbs/Blooming Burst/Pop Blossom. win[] and phases[3,5,6] left untouched since already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko is misgendered as 'he/his' in tldr, three dosFull/dontsFull titles, and two report entries.
audit.why: Neeko is on the female enemy list; third-person pronouns describing the enemy must be she/her.
audit.corrected: See per-field edits — every 'he/his' referring to Neeko changed to 'she/her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Bard's Cosmic Binding (Q) / Magical Journey (E) shut off Pop Blossom's leap, which isn't stated anywhere — dosFull[1].d is currently a copy-paste bleed of tradeGood instead.
audit.why: Pop Blossom (R) is flagged 'dash: mobility that grounding and walls can deny' — a landed stun or portal-block during the leap denies the engage outright.
audit.corrected: Pop Blossom's leap is a dash — a landed Q stun or E portal-block shuts it down cold. Hold it for the engage, not the poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Tangle-Barbs matchup-defining but never gives its cooldown (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — naming it tells the reader exactly how long the safe window is.
audit.corrected: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — the root sets up her whole burst, so sidestep it behind minions. Magical Journey (E) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. Spend the R on swing moments only.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Cosmic Binding' as fuzzy, but it's Bard's real Q name — false positive.
